proposal_sections.tool: LbaCas12a with crRNA reporter and RPA amplification
proposal_sections.target: Femtomolar LOD detection of mcr-1 antibiotic resistance gene
proposal_sections.methodology: Water samples from aquaculture facilities and multidrug-resistant clinical isolates will be tested. Recombinant Cas12a endonuclease will be complexed with synthetic guide RNA to trigger collateral ssDNA cleavage. Target DNA amplification will use isothermal RPA. Biosafety precautions follow standard lab rules.
